categories.main_business_segments: Kanamoto Co., Ltd. operates two main business segments: the Construction-related segment, which centers on the rental and sale of construction machinery and temporary construction materials, and the Other segment, which includes steel-related, information-related, and welfare-related businesses. The Construction-related segment is the core, accounting for the vast majority of revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core operations rely on the efficient procurement, maintenance, and lifecycle management of a large fleet of construction machinery and equipment, utilizing both direct ownership and group-wide asset sharing. Kanamoto employs advanced asset management, regular renewal of emission-compliant and eco-friendly machinery, and digital transformation (DX) initiatives such as ICT construction methods, remote and automated operation, and BIM/CIM integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kanamoto primarily serves construction companies involved in public and private infrastructure projects, including civil engineering, urban redevelopment, disaster prevention, and semiconductor plant construction. Its customer base spans general contractors, subcontractors, and specialized construction firms, with additional markets in steel, IT equipment, and welfare/healthcare sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively throughout Japan, with a strong presence in Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto-Koshinetsu, Western Japan, and Kyushu-Okinawa. Internationally, Kanamoto has subsidiaries and affiliates in Australia, China, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, and the Philippines, with domestic sales comprising over 90% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kanamoto is positioned downstream in the supply chain, acting as a service provider that rents, sells, and maintains construction equipment and related products to end users in the construction and infrastructure sectors. It also engages in some upstream activities through the procurement and resale of used equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the revenue base through asset efficiency and productivity improvements, expanding overseas operations, and enhancing DX initiatives such as digitalization, automation, and ICT-enabled construction. The company emphasizes sustainability, decarbonization, and ESG management, with ongoing investments in eco-friendly equipment and human capital development. There is no significant in-house R&D, but Kanamoto actively adopts and integrates new technologies from equipment manufacturers.
categories.revenue_model: Kanamoto generates revenue primarily through the rental of construction machinery and equipment, supplemented by the sale of new and used equipment, steel products, IT equipment, and welfare-related goods. Rental contracts are typically short-term and usage-based, while sales are recognized upon delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kanamoto is one of Japan’s leading general equipment rental companies, competing with other major rental firms such as Nishio Rent All and Nikken Corporation. The company is recognized as an industry leader, particularly in Hokkaido and Kyushu, and differentiates itself through its extensive asset base, nationwide network, and comprehensive service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending October 2024, Kanamoto reported consolidated net sales of 207.2 billion yen, operating profit of 14.6 billion yen, and net income attributable to parent shareholders of 9.0 billion yen. The company has approximately 3,900 employees and continues to show steady growth, with a 4.9% year-on-year increase in sales and a 21.9% increase in ordinary profit. The balance sheet is robust, with total assets of 322.9 billion yen and an equity ratio of 43.4%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kanamoto emphasizes its ability to provide a one-stop, general rental solution with a wide range of equipment, rapid response to customer needs, and high asset availability. The company’s focus on sustainability, digital transformation, and asset efficiency, combined with its nationwide and international network, enables it to deliver reliable, cost-effective, and environmentally conscious solutions to construction and infrastructure clients.
